rationale: No displayed candidate contains the child’s distinctive customs-field machinery: designating and revoking customs ports of entry and extending port limits within specified customs collection districts. C17 is the closest structural analogue because it changes the organization and locations of government field offices and supplies an effective-date clause, but its operative language and administrative mechanism are materially different. C10 similarly makes enumerated additions and corrections to an existing administrative list, while C15 uses detailed geographic descriptions, but neither plausibly supplied concrete drafting material for the child. The overlaps are generic forms of administrative amendment or geographic specification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Elkin, North Carolina, is designated as a customs port of entry... The designation of Cheboygan, Michigan, as a customs port of entry... is revoked.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The district land offices at Blackfoot and Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, shall be discontinued... [and] a new district land office... established and maintained at Boise, Idaho.
shared_material.explanation: C17 shares an enumerated field-organization adjustment involving establishment and discontinuance of locations, but it lacks the child’s customs-port terminology, repeated designation/revocation formula, and collection-district framework.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall become effective on the thirtieth day following the date hereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall become effective at the close of business on August 13, 1948.
shared_material.explanation: The shared effective-date device in C17 is routine administrative boilerplate and does not establish templating.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The limits of the customs port of entry of Alexandria Bay, New York... are extended to include the Township of Alexandria...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: RURAL: Parcel of land located in Wards Sabana and Pitahaya... bounded on the North... on the South... on the East... and on the West...
shared_material.explanation: C15 also precisely describes geographic areas, but those descriptions serve land-transfer conveyancing rather than the extension of administrative port boundaries.
